# S25 — Shared shopping list UI

The shared list both phones use: add, check, remove, staples one-tap, ordered by category (L1, L4).

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:** web

**Not in this slice:** sending the list to a store; offline editing.

## Why

This is the second everyday screen. Items anyone adds from the kitchen must show up on whichever phone is used to place the order.

## Owner input

None if the list interview is done. Confirm the final wording of buttons with the owner.

Owner decisions: 2026-11-04, ADR 0020 (S23): phones poll every few seconds, no live push; checked items are struck through until 'Clear'; the list resets with a manual 'Ordered' button, not weekly; free-text items are allowed; one category order for every store. The final button wording is still to confirm with the owner.

Owner decisions: 2026-11-05, from S22: the Today view links to /list, so S25 registers the list page at the path /list.

Owner decisions: 2026-11-06, answered by the owner: the button wording is 'Add' (the add box), 'Clear checked' (removes the struck-through items) and 'Ordered' (resets the list after the order is placed); the staples drawer is titled 'Staples'. The wording question is closed.

Owner decisions: 2026-11-06, spec-check answers: (1) the polling version is a content hash of the active list's rows (item, qty, unit, checked, added_by) and the staples; the endpoint returns the fragment when the phone's version differs and 204 when it matches; no migration; poll interval 5 seconds; (2) 'Ordered' sets archived_at on the active list and starts a new empty one, so checked and unchecked items are all gone; plan items return only when a plan is next confirmed or edited and regenerate runs; (3) the Staples drawer lists existing staple rows with one-tap add; creating staples is out of this slice (the owner files a staple-management slice before the trial) and tests insert staple rows directly; (4) the Check is tightened to: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_list_web passes all named tests, the full suite passes, and ruff check . and ruff format --check . exit 0, with the 5 second poll interval stated; the two-browser look is the owner's trial. Any further small implementation detail this spec does not cover is the implementer's call within the decisions above; list each such choice in the report's deviations so the owner can review it.
